name: Ruins - an acolytes of the Chrystals story
source:
"Ruins; an acolytes of the Chrystal" follows a young courier who is tasked with bringing an important scroll from one end of an enchanted forest to the other. On the way, he meets a large orc, who tags along on the journey.

The two of them now have to learn to trust each other as they get deeper and deeper into the forest and uncover the secrets that lie there.

[From [url=https://mystery-zone-games.itch.io/ruins]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《Ruins; an acolytes of the Chrystal》講述一名年輕的信使受命將一卷重要卷軸從魔法森林的一端送往另一端。途中，他遇到一名高大的獸人，對方加入了這趟旅程。

隨著兩人不斷深入森林，他們必須學會彼此信任，並揭開潛藏其中的秘密。

[來源：[url=https://mystery-zone-games.itch.io/ruins]Itch.io[/url]]
